correctness.rationale: At a=b/d symmetric Nash equilibrium p1=p2=3, quantity demanded is 1/2; the published 2x2 Jacobian specializes to entries 1-3t,t,t(1-3t/2),1-3t+t²/2. Direct trace/determinant algebra gives exact Schur/Jury factors (3t-2)^2, 8t², t(12-17t)/2. Thus precisely 0<t<12/17 except t=2/3 is linearly asymptotically stable. At t=7/10 all factors (1/100,98/25,7/200) are positive and the determinant is 193/200. At t=2/3 an eigenvalue is -1, not a stability interval. This disproves only the unconditional exact-boundary wording, not the source sufficient theorem.
